correctness.rationale: For n≥2 and m=n+2, let Q=sqrt(n/m)U with QᵀQ=I. An orthogonal completion W has two columns and squared row norms 2/m. Writing W_i=sqrt(2/m)(cosθ_i,sinθ_i), WᵀW=I₂ is equivalent to ∑e^{2iθ_i}=0. Jacobi complementary minors give c_B=(m^{n-2}/n^n)|z_i-z_j|² for the omitted pair. Jung (or the source’s Carathéodory circle argument) gives max chord²≥3. Equality forces three equally populated cubic-root positions, possible iff 3|m; direct completion realizes them, and compactness gives a positive strict gap at fixed 3∤m. Reconstructed all seven Git blob identities and tree; independently computed exact-rational all n-principal minors of the extremal Gram matrices at m=6,9,12, yielding 27/64 at m=6. These finite checks are corroboration only. Hypotheses real/equal norm/positive equal weight and no factorial normalization are essential.

originality.rationale: The precise determinant coefficient and all equality configurations are mathematically correct, but the only purported new geometric step is a direct planar specialization of Jung’s 1901 diameter/circumradius theorem. The normalizations and Jacobi–Naimark complementary minors are already standard. For phases z_i on the unit circle with sum zero, min_a (1/m) sum|z_i-a|²=1+|a|², proving minimum enclosing radius exactly 1. Jung therefore gives D²≥3, with equality forcing an equilateral support; zero mean forces equal multiplicities. Substituting the established complementary-minor identity yields the complete asserted formula and equality/strictness classification. This is a routine corollary of known results rather than a genuinely original independent theorem, even though older work does not list this exact frame formula.
residual_risks: No statement that every historical paper was searched; this scientific rejection rests instead on a concrete exact implication of classical Jung and frame-minor identities.
Source claim was not shown to be false; it is a genuine correct but classically implied bound.
Some differently named historical frame papers may state the same corollary explicitly; this would reinforce rather than reverse the negative originality assessment.

value.rationale: The extremal question is motivated by determinant selection and equal-leverage tight-frame design. Its exact sharp improvement over the general Cauchy–Binet guarantee, complete three-line equality classification, and divisibility obstruction are potentially useful structural specifications for the natural infinite codimension-two class. Nonetheless the calculation is a short consequence of existing geometry and hence fails originality; value here does not establish independent novelty. It does not determine exact minima for 3∤m nor treat arbitrary weights.
